Regional Africa is the province's steadiest volume and its least developed premium market: Zimbabwe and Namibia supply 62% of African arrivals, while West African visitors spend the most per visit.
**December 2025.** Build a Regional Foundation (Africa) (Current State Diagnostic, Dec 2025, p64).

**October 2026: Validated.** Regional routes are full, and Nigerian and Ghanaian visitors spend R31,000 and R27,700 each. The Demand-Side African opportunity section, the Skift African memo and MIDAS's regional route loads drove the disposition.

blocks.caption: African demand is a Southern African volume base with two high-spending West African markets and regional routes above 80% load.

blocks.text: Three cautions apply. Nigeria and Ghana have no row in the growth model, so no 2035 arrivals figure exists for the two highest-spending African markets [Nigeria and Ghana arrivals targets: not modelled; Wesgro Research to add both]. The Skift memo places Ghana in its watch tier for brand seeding rather than conversion (Skift African Market Analysis, 16 Mar 2026, s5). And regional travellers tend to stop in Johannesburg rather than continue to Cape Town (Stakeholder Insights Report, Mar 2026, p35).

Wesgro should run Africa as two markets: a regional volume base held through capacity and value, and a premium growth market in Nigeria and Kenya won through conversion. Skift makes Nigeria the priority for luxury, status-driven and conference travel and Kenya the priority for business mobility and premium urban breaks, both through premium activation and the trade (Skift African Market Analysis, 16 Mar 2026, s5). Regional demand also helps the green season, because trips are shorter in lead time and easier to convert (Current State Diagnostic, Dec 2025, p31).

rows: Make the capacity case on the five full regional routes with Airlink, Ethiopian Airlines, Kenya Airways and the other regional carriers
Run premium, trade-led activation in Nigeria and Kenya for leisure, weddings and conferences with leisure extensions
Add Nigeria and Ghana to the growth model and commission consumer research for Botswana, Zambia, Ghana and Rwanda
Convert rest-of-Africa travellers who stop in Johannesburg with onward packages, and give regional delegates leisure extensions
Cape Town Tourism; CTICC; tour operators; Cross-Border Road Transport Agency
Escalate visas for African markets, building on the Ghana visa waiver of November 2023, and liberalisation of regional air routes

blocks.text: Kenya draws 41% of its arrivals from Africa, mainly Uganda and Tanzania, and positions Nairobi as East Africa's aviation, diplomatic and business hub through Kenya Airways' regional network (Global Benchmarking Report, Mar 2026, p32, p34). The transferable changes the deck draws for the Western Cape are to treat MICE as a system lever and to align city, provincial and national actors around one gateway strategy (p35).

**Initiative I5**, regional Africa programme (section 4.3), with the regional capacity case run under **I6** (focus area 7). **Indicators** T1-02 arrivals by market group at impact level and T2-08 African arrivals and spend at outcome level (section 5.2).
